implemented_subset.bpm_basis: Six native options in REAPER order: 1/8, 1/4, 1/2, 1/8 dotted, 1/4 dotted, 1/2 dotted; default 1/4. BPM is interpreted as beats of the selected note value.
implemented_subset.start_measure: Signed i32 displayed measure at tick zero; 0 and -2 accepted by native UI and AAADAW
implemented_subset.project_start_time: Signed project clock display offset; shifts ruler/transport and absolute item time displays without moving media samples or changing musical positions
implemented_subset.start_time_measure_menu: All five native menu entries modeled: the first four set/reset time and measure values; the fifth toggles whether fractional-frame start offsets are allowed. Up/Down cycle, Enter executes, Escape closes; commands update the General draft until OK.
implemented_subset.fractional_frame_start_offset: Unchecked by default; persists through schema 33 and is stored in REAPER RPP TIMEMODE's final flag field (0 off, 4 on). Its video/timecode alignment effect still needs verification.
implemented_subset.force_tempo_changes_to_whole_samples: Unchecked and disabled when project sample rate is not enabled. RPP SAMPLERATE's third field is 0 by default, 1 when enabled; AAADAW persists the flag in schema 34 and rounds tempo-map sample anchors when enabled.
implemented_subset.musical_positions: Signed displayed bars round-trip in Beats properties and anchor timeline ruler labels
implemented_subset.base_ruler_label_spacing: Checked by default; checked uses start_measure as the ruler-label interval phase, unchecked uses measure 1
implemented_subset.apply: one atomic transaction: changed fields among SetTempo@0 + SetTimeSignature@0 + SetProjectSampleRate + SetForceTempoChangesToWholeSamples + SetProjectStartMeasure + SetProjectBpmBasis + SetBaseRulerLabelSpacingOnMeasure + SetProjectStartTimeOffsetSeconds + SetProjectStartTimeFractionalFrameOffsetAllowed

limitations: The fractional-frame flag is stored and editable; its video/timecode alignment behavior remains unverified. Whole-sample mode rounds tempo-map sample anchors; native marker-edit snapping behavior and meter-marker-specific effects still need verification. The project-rate enable/hardware-default behavior, display timebase, beat-synced audio item storage, resampling UI/settings, and render mode remain unimplemented. AAADAW's background media worker uses a 64-tap Blackman-windowed sinc path, but its coefficients have not been verified against REAPER
Default values came from the owned ReaScript probe; REAPER 7.82 General screenshots and SAMPLERATE field comparisons are committed alongside the AAADAW evidence
